title: A planned goal that names its sources by a rule (a commit's changed rows) lists their ids, so done accepts each re-read source's ledger rows
goal: BG-c2pp5wwl's goal named its sources as 'each other source whose _fetch_state.csv baseline commit 5f16b6d63 advanced', and done refused its landing over S742's rows (outside-touches: ledger rows of sources the goal does not name), because done reads source ids only from the goal text and the facts touched. backlog.py check warns of a committed item whose goal names sources by such a rule with no id list, or done accepts the ids an item lists in a field of its own; either way a re-read of the rule's sources lands without a goal edit (found by the SP-gcerxjsg retrospective).
notes: Triage 2026-10-16: its check names a test the pruned suite (D-6kei5o2z) lacks; no planted check yet: Goal leaves the mechanism open (check warning, or done accepting ids from an item field) and names no field or function; unrelated_baselines needs ledger commits to plant.
